stem: According to the developmental timeline provided, which area of the brain is the last to reach full maturity?
explanation: This region, responsible for higher-level regulation and reasoning, continues to mature well into the 20s.
rationale: Focus on the region responsible for complex planning and impulse control.

optionExplanations.A: The parietal areas are mentioned as maturing earlier in the adolescent period compared to the frontal regions.
optionExplanations.B: While temporal areas peak later than some cortical regions, they are not the very last to finish maturing.
optionExplanations.C: This region, responsible for higher-level regulation and reasoning, continues to mature well into the 20s.
optionExplanations.D: The source specifically emphasizes the late maturation of the frontal and prefrontal areas rather than the visual processing centers.
